2610.09788.title: Judging in Latent Space: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Semantics-Preserving Compression
2610.09788.paper_summary: Reward modeling often requires jointly representing and reasoning over multiple evaluation criteria, yet verbalizing this process token by token can incur substantial inference cost. Recent work on latent reasoning suggests that continuous states may support this computation more compactly. We introduce LatentGRM, a latent evaluation framework built on semantic chunking, compression, and reconstruction. By using the structure of rubric-guided evaluations to guide compression, LatentGRM learns compact continuous trajectories that support autonomous pairwise judgments without generating textual assessments. A separate interpreter reconstructs evaluation text from these trajectories, providing an offline view of the information retained under compression. Under matched training data and backbones, LatentGRM achieves competitive aggregate preference accuracy relative to explicit Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) judges at both 4B and 8B scales. Across four benchmark domains, LatentGRM-8B compresses evaluation trajectories by 8.9--9.2x and reduces total judge inference time by 6.1--7.0x at vote@5. Controlled rubric interventions show that criterion-dependent preference information is carried through the latent sequence. Together, these results demonstrate that continuous latent evaluation can substantially reduce inference cost while preserving competitive judgment quality.
2610.09788.paper_summary_zh: 獎勵建模通常需要共同表示和推理多個評估標準，但逐字表達這一過程可能會產生相當大的推理成本。最近關於潛在推理的研究表明，連續狀態可能更緊湊地支持這一計算。我們介紹了LatentGRM，一個基於語義分塊、壓縮和重建的潛在評估框架。通過利用評分指導評估的結構來指導壓縮，LatentGRM學習到緊湊的連續軌跡，支持自主的成對判斷，而無需生成文本評估。一個單獨的解釋器從這些軌跡中重建評估文本，提供壓縮下保留的信息的離線視圖。在匹配的訓練數據和骨幹下，LatentGRM在4B和8B規模上相對於明確的監督微調（SFT）評委實現了具有競爭力的總體偏好準確性。在四個基準領域中，LatentGRM-8B將評估軌跡壓縮了8.9--9.2倍，並在vote@5時將總評委推理時間減少了6.1--7.0倍。控制評分標準的干預顯示，依賴標準的偏好信息是通過潛在序列傳遞的。綜合這些結果表明，連續潛在評估可以在保留競爭性判斷質量的同時顯著降低推理成本。
